# Position Xero

> Position Xero is an American performance marketing and lead generation agency based in Alpine, Wyoming. We help US service businesses generate consistent, qualified leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and conversion-focused website design.

> Last updated: 2026-07-11

## What We Do

- **Google Ads Management** — Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube campaigns. Minimum ad spend: $500/month. Retainer from $850/month.
- **Meta Ads Management** — Facebook and Instagram advertising. Minimum ad spend: $300/month. Retainer from $750/month.
- **Lead Generation** — Multi-channel campaigns (paid ads, cold email, SEO, landing pages) targeting 20-50 qualified leads/month.
- **SEO Services** — Traditional on-page/technical SEO, AI SEO for Google AI Overviews, and LLM SEO for ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini citations. Local SEO from $600/month, full SEO from $1,000/month.
- **Website and Landing Page Design** — High-converting, SEO-optimized HTML pages. Landing pages from $750, full sites from $1,800.

## Who We Serve

- Attorneys and law firms (personal injury, family law, criminal defense)
- Real estate agents and property investment agencies
- Recruitment and staffing agencies
- Service-based businesses: roofing, plumbing, pool companies, cleaning, HVAC, contractors

## Results We've Achieved

- Average 300% increase in qualified leads within 90 days
- Average 62% reduction in cost per lead across Google Ads clients
- $500,000+ total ad spend managed
- 4.9/5 average rating from 50+ clients
- Law firm: CPL reduced from $450 to $89 in 6 weeks
- Real estate agency: 47 qualified leads in first 30 days (was 8/month)
- Roofing company: 312% organic traffic growth in 90 days

## Differentiators

- Month-to-month contracts only — no lock-in
- Direct access to the people running your campaigns — no account managers
- Open-book reporting: CPL, ROAS, revenue — not impressions
- 24-hour response guarantee
- Free audit delivered as a personalized Loom video within 48 hours
